questions.stem: A cylindrical tin has radius $4\text{ cm}$ and height $10\text{ cm}$. What is the area of the label that wraps around the curved surface? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
A cylinder has a total surface area of $130\pi\text{ cm}^2$ and a radius of $5\text{ cm}$. What is its height?
questions.explanation: $2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh = 130\pi$. So $2(25)\pi + 2(5)h\pi = 130\pi$, giving $50 + 10h = 130$, hence $h = 8\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: An open-top cylinder (no lid) has radius $r$ and height $h$. Its total surface area is:
questions.explanation: An open-top cylinder has one circular base ($\pi r^2$) and the curved surface ($2\pi rh$), giving $\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh$.
